messages:
Jordan C: Heads up — vendor reported H100 driver validation slip and Gaudi perf variance; might push our coordinated marketplace announce ~10d. Need triage on press embargo vs SI onramp.
Amanda L: Which SKUs and what breaks? Embargo timing or capacity hit?
Jordan C: Affected: H100 images (firmware/drivers) and one Gaudi perf harness. MI300 unaffected. Main risk = press embargo & SI dry-run windows.
Ravi S: For marketplace we can decouple press from provisioning: announce generally but tag SKUs as unavailable in affected regions. We'll need SKU tags + docs.
Marco V: Fallback plan: (1) announce with limited SKUs, (2) enable H200/B200 as fallback, (3) update SI runbook. Quick checklist: tag SKUs with `embargo:delayed`, enable fallback images, notify SIs.
Olivia P: Who will push tags? I can call infra API but need exact tag keys and SKU list.
Jordan C: Olivia please own tagging. Use tags: `embargo:delayed`, `fallback:enabled`, `press:ok`.
Dana R: I'll draft partner email. Jordan — if we use H200 fallback, what's the capacity/latency delta?
Jordan C: H200 fallback ≈ -25% concurrent slots, tail latency +5–10%.
Amanda L: Can routing auto-fallback, or will SIs manually switch?
Ravi S: We can do policy routing: if sku_tag==delayed route to fallback_model. I'll push a routing rule to staging.
DeployBot: deploy job #4822 started by Ravi S — creating routing rule `sku_fallback_policy_v2` in staging
Marco V: Press/Comms note: if vendor insists on keeping embargo date, legal will need precise wording: "phased availability" + region list.
Olivia P: Marketplace tagging endpoint: /marketplace/api/v1/skus/<sku>/tags. I can push tags EOD. Need SKU list.
Jordan C: SKU list: H100-v1, H100-v1-32G, Gaudi-v3-alpha, Gaudi-v3-beta. Fallbacks: H200-v2, B200-v1.
Dana R: Email outline ready: cause, fallback, ETA, SI action items, contacts. Will send after tags and routing rule confirm.
Amanda L: Internal FAQ in progress for sales/support: affected regions, how to request early access.
Ravi S: Add temporary metric: if fallback_rate >10% for a SKU, page eng-runtime.
Jordan C: Marco — can you draft embargo-safe blurb and loop in legal tomorrow morning?
Marco V: On it. I'll post draft to comms repo under `comm/embargo_phased.md`.
Olivia P: Tagged H100-v1 and H100-v1-32G with `embargo:delayed` + `fallback:enabled`. Gaudi tests still running.
DeployBot: deploy job #4822 succeeded — routing rule `sku_fallback_policy_v2` applied in staging
Ravi S: Routing rule live in staging; alert `fallback_rate_alert` created.
Olivia P: Gaudi perf fix landed, running full regression — ETA ~90m.
Marco V: If Gaudi regression passes, untag + 6hr NA canary then global. Notify partners 1h before untag.
Dana R: Will include canary windows in follow-up.
Jordan C: Update before stand: Gaudi regression green, Olivia canary promote?
Olivia P: Promoting to canary now. Will add `press:ok` if canary healthy.
Ravi S: Monitoring metrics. Will watch fallback traffic and latency during canary.
Jordan C: Thanks all — reconvene in 2h or earlier if things move.
